title: Reading lexical string order
description: You can follow seven string pairs into three comparison branches.

steps.description: pairs stores seven rows of two strings. You use sizeof to compute how many rows the loop will visit.
strcmp compares the contents of the current two strings. You store its result and print the pair being compared.

steps.question: Does the equality branch require a particular positive result?
steps.answer: No. It runs when result is zero; negative and positive results take the two ordering branches.

steps.description: The supplied output identifies equal strings, apple before banana and banana after apple. You also see case-sensitive ordering and equality for two empty strings.
